quarterly_data.quarter: 10x Genomics press release: 10x Genomics Begins Global Shipments of Atera, Putting (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 10x Genomics announced the first commercial shipments of Atera, its spatial platform introduced in April of this year that combines whole transcriptome analysis, sub-cellular resolution and single cell sensitivity; the company says Atera is now shipping to customers worldwide.

quarterly_data.quarter: 10x Genomics press release: 10x Genomics Begins Global Shipments of Atera, Putting (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: nearly all of the world's top 20 R&D-spending biopharma companies are either purchasing Atera systems or services through its service lab, Catalyst Research Services (CRS). In just five months CRS projects have been booked across more than 100 customers, a meaningful portion from biopharma, and 10x is now preparing to run the first customer samples through the service.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 100 customers booked in five months; nearly all of the top 20 R&D-spending biopharma companies

quarterly_data.quarter: 10x Genomics press release: 10x Genomics Begins Global Shipments of Atera, Putting (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Allen Institute: among the first organizations to receive Atera, with three instruments planned to support research across immunology, neuroscience and synthetic biology.

quarterly_data.quarter: 10x Genomics press release: 10x Genomics Begins Global Shipments of Atera, Putting (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Biohub: plans to use Atera to generate multiomic and morphology data at scale to train AI foundation models that can predict cellular responses to genetic and pharmacologic perturbations.

quarterly_data.quarter: 10x Genomics press release: 10x Genomics Begins Global Shipments of Atera, Putting (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Procter & Gamble: enhancing its spatial biology program through 10x's Catalyst Research Services to apply Atera to its skin research.

quarterly_data.quarter: 10x Genomics press release: 10x Genomics Begins Global Shipments of Atera, Putting (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other named Atera users: Wellcome Sanger Institute; MD Anderson Cancer Center (translational cancer research); TGen, part of City of Hope, which plans to offer Atera through its COSMO core services; and the ASTRA consortium (Garvan Institute and University of Tokyo), which reached approximately 50% of its original three-year goal to profile 2,000 tumors in one year and plans to use Atera to expand its atlas to 5,000 tumors over the next two years.
quarterly_data.figure: ASTRA: approximately 50% of 2,000-tumor goal; 5,000 tumors over the next two years

quarterly_data.quarter: 10x Genomics press release: 10x Genomics Begins Global Shipments of Atera, Putting (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Atera roadmap (no dates given): planned mouse whole transcriptome capabilities, onboard slide prep automation (company calls it a first of its kind capability), RNA-protein multiomics with customizable protein panels, and in situ base-by-base mutation detection (also described by the company as first of its kind).
